items.title: John "Picky" Brunious Interview, 1959-05-26
items.q: But up until today, my favorite trumpet player is Roy Eldridge.

ctx.x: I mean, I was playing that well, I mean, over men, you know? See? But like I said, I mean, I was copying those records. Following behind Louis Armstrong and this guy and that guy, see? But up until today, my favorite trumpet player is Roy Eldridge. That's my favorite, you know? Because my son and I always have a big discussion about Roy Eldridge. He like Dizzy Gillespie, you know? Quite natural. I mean, he's young. I mean, he come up in that stage, you know? To Dizzy Gillespie, see? So we got a record there with…
